summary: Pharvaris N.V., a Netherlands-based biopharmaceutical company, filed a Form 6-K on September 8, 2026, reporting positive topline data from its CHAPTER-3 pivotal Phase 3 study of deucrictibant XR for prophylaxis of hereditary angioedema (HAE) attacks. The study met its primary endpoint, showing an 83% attack rate reduction versus placebo (p<0.0001) across all HAE types, with all secondary endpoints met. The press release details study design—85 participants randomized 2:1 to deucrictibant XR or placebo—and notes planned marketing authorization applications starting in H1 2027. This is a clinical trial results announcement, not a special-situation transaction. What to watch: upcoming regulatory submissions and potential commercialization milestones.
